plainTranslation: Thinking faces drive across the table. The Mercury person wants to discuss; the Mars person wants to act. Lively debate that can tip into argument, each finding the other too slow or too hasty. Failure mode: a constant low-grade fight. Let the debate sharpen you both rather than divide you.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
